info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Rides Cancellation API allows service providers to efficiently cancel scheduled rides in the rideshare platform. This functionality is essential for managing customer requests and ensuring operational flexibility. It can be used by rideshare operators and fleet managers to handle cancellations swiftly and maintain accurate ride availability. The API supports seamless integration with existing rideshare applications, enhancing user experience and operational control.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a previously booked ride by providing the relevant ride identification. It ensures that the cancellation process is smooth and feedback is given to the user, while also updating any necessary backend systems to reflect the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to cancel a ride. Ensure that all necessary information is provided to successfully process the cancellation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.title: Cancel Ride Request
DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: Schema representing the body of a request to cancel a ride operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.title: Ride Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier representing the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the ride after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or message regarding the cancellation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.description: Response schema for a successful ride cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains details about the creation and modification of the cancellation request.

x-processing-time.description: The total time, in milliseconds, spent processing the request. This value can help assess the performance of the endpoint.
